{@link EnumUtils#generateBitVectors(Class, Iterable)} only accepts enum classes. Passing a non-enum class (here {@code Object.class}) must be rejected with an {@link IllegalArgumentException}, even when the supplied values are empty.

Raw types are used deliberately: the method's generic bound {@code >} would otherwise reject {@code Object.class} at compile time, preventing us from exercising the runtime validation.
